shared_elements: repeated row of short parallel strokes forming a band
justification: The only real overlap is a profile quadruped and a band of repeated short strokes (curls of fleece in A, crew-strokes along a hull in B), both of which are generic and arise here for entirely different reasons. A is a large naturalistic horned bull/ram head and body in close-up relief with elaborately patterned mane and fleece, while B is a flat schematic scene dominated by a long boat with upturned prow and stern, a small stick animal and isolated linear marks; no shared relationships or arrangement.
